findings.description: Independent DOM parse of the pinned ECE people-list page enumerated 68 entries ({'Core': 41, 'Lecturer': 1, 'Senior Research Scholar': 1, 'Associated Faculty': 14, 'Visiting Faculty': 6, 'Emeritus Faculty': 5}); they exactly equal the required person set and all 22 profile URLs are present in the pinned captures (Associated Faculty has 14, not 15 entries). The first (primary) block has no visible heading in the captured DOM; it is treated as the ECE core faculty list since every entry carries a professorial ECE title or ECE-chair title.

Alex White: Visiting Research Scholar now, "Incoming Assistant Professor (9/1/2027)" on his ECE profile. Included as regular/incoming with effective date 2027-09-01 (day precision). Department is not named in the role field, but the profile is hosted in the ECE directory and describes EE/photonics research.

Other Visiting Faculty checked in full: David Cahen (Kenan Visiting Professor for Distinguished Teaching), Yuxin Chen (Wharton, UPenn), Mung Chiang (Purdue), Andrea Goldsmith (Stony Brook president; Princeton ECE professor/dean 2020-2025 per bio), Jason D. Lee (UC Berkeley; former Princeton associate professor). None announces a future or current regular ECE appointment; all excluded as visiting.

Associated Faculty (14: Ahmadi, Allen-Blanchette, Arnold, August, Fan, Jamieson, Kol, Li, Loo, Martonosi, Paulino, Rexford, Sood, Stellato) are professors in ORFE/MAE/CS/Finance/Engineering holding the official "ECE Associated Faculty" designation; recorded affiliate_professor (included) per the policy category_rules, membership ece.

Core titles for Chou, Kahn, Malik, Poor and Viswanath are named chairs / University Professor without "ECE" in the list text; they sit in the ECE primary faculty block. Core profile pages were not part of the pinned captures.
